## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:workflow` · `pm:queue`. Direction: the preview carries every key `ScreenView` renders, from one list

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-09-30T10:53Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/screen-spec.ts` (`toScreenFields`) ⇒ `domain:ui`.

**Why p2.** The preview contradicts its own promise ("exactly as the end user will see it at runtime") on a named producer: objectstack `examples/app-todo`'s `screen_1` shows two selects as text boxes. It takes the preview family's p2 (objectui#11128, #11148).

**Direction.** As the card states:
- ⛔ No second hand-kept key list. The projection is derived from, or pinned against, what `ScreenView` reads.
- **`defaultValue`: show the literal with a marker.** The preview has no run context to interpolate `{…}` tokens. Rendering a guessed value would be a second interpolation rule. The Debug run stays the place that interpolates.
- **Pins:**
  - `screen_1`'s shape renders two comboboxes in the preview, as at runtime;
  - a `placeholder` shows;
  - a `defaultValue` template shows literally, with its marker;
  - a key-less field is unchanged (the control).

`finding` comes off at grading.

Claim: PM loop round 9 — `domain:ui` execution seat 2
Session: `session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`
Account: `os-support-ai` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-11190-screen-preview-projection`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-11190`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#2`
File surface (triage `5909747834`: the preview carries every key `ScreenView` renders, from one list; `defaultValue` shown literally, with a marker):
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/screen-spec.ts` (`toScreenFields`).
- `ScreenPreview.tsx`, only as far as the `defaultValue` literal marker needs it.
- Pins beside them, and one changeset.
Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (TIER_DEFAULT; `dispatch-gates` has no objectui derivation, so there is no path-derived mandate; objectstack `41dcf118`)
Clause-②: no
Why no: an internal projection. No schema, prop, type or accepted set moves.
Thread-read: 5909747834
Serial constraints cleared: read 2026-09-30T10:59Z at objectui `origin/main` `846cec0ef`.
- PR objectui#11188 (objectui#9248, the same function's four keys) landed as `81778b955`.
- No open PR touches `previews/screen-spec.ts` or `ScreenPreview.tsx`. PR objectui#10278 edits `previews/block-config.ts` only.
